base_template: Write a support ticket from a junior admin at {{company_name}}. The {{server_type}} at {{server_ip}} in the {{location}} office is unreachable from the client network ({{client_ip}}). Routing and interfaces are correctly configured. A firewall policy issue is suspected.

company_name.instruction: Generate a professional tech company name

server_type.instruction: Pick one: Database Server, File Server, or Internal Web Portal

server_ip.instruction: A private IP in 10.x.x.x range, last octet 50-150 (avoid .1 and .10)

client_ip.instruction: A private IP in 192.168.x.x range, last octet 50-150 (avoid .1 and .10). Different /24 from server_ip

expected_solution: Add a firewall rule on pfSense under Firewall > Rules > OPT1 (em1) to allow traffic from client_subnet to server_ip. Optionally add logging.
